sync.pendingLong_other: {{count}} changes saved on this phone, waiting to sync

sync.rejected_other: {{count}} changes weren't accepted by the server
sync.rejectedHint: They stay on this phone. This usually means your role changed to viewer.

setup.title: Set up your family ledger
setup.body: One ledger per family. Everyone you invite sees and adds to the same register.
setup.nameHint: You'll be the owner. You can rename it later.
setup.codeHint: Ask the ledger owner for a code. Codes expire 48 hours after they're made.
setup.joined: Joined {{name}}. Its gifts will appear once sync arrives.

home.emptyBody: Create your own function to log gifts you receive, or another family's function to log what you gave.

events.title: Events
events.emptyBody: Create an event for your own function, or for one you're attending.

createEvent.title: New event
createEvent.functionsHint: gifts can be logged against each

scan.title: Scan invite card
scan.body: Take a photo of the card, or pick one you got on WhatsApp. The text is read on this phone; the photo isn't saved or uploaded.
scan.foundHint: You can change anything on the next screen.
scan.nothingFound: Couldn't make out the details on this card. Try a sharper photo taken straight on, or type the event in.
scan.unavailable: Reading cards needs the Android app built with npx expo run:android or EAS. Expo Go and the web preview can't do it.
scan.cameraDenied: Camera access is off. Allow it in Settings, or choose a photo from the gallery.
scan.failed: Couldn't read that photo. Try another one.
scan.filled: Filled in from the invite card. Check each detail, then create the event.

eventDetail.emptyBody: Everything saves on this phone, even without signal.
eventDetail.notFound: This event is no longer in the ledger.
eventDetail.entryActions: Long press an entry to edit or delete it

people.title: People
people.legend: ↗ given by you · ↙ received from them
people.emptyBody: People are added when you log a gift or create an event for another family.

person.notFound: This person is no longer in the ledger.
person.nameHint: Write it the way the family says it. Hindi or English both work.

duplicates.bannerHint: Same name or phone number. Review before merging.
duplicates.title: Possible duplicates
duplicates.hint: Same name in Hindi or English, or the same phone number. Nothing merges until you review it.
duplicates.emptyBody: People with the same name (in Hindi or English) or the same phone number show up here.

merge.title: Merge people
merge.pickHint: Find the other entry for the same person or household.
merge.keepHint: The other one's gifts move to the one you keep, and its city, phone and relation fill any blanks.
merge.summary: {{what}} will move to {{name}}, and {{other}} leaves People on every phone in the family.
merge.summaryEmpty: {{other}} has nothing to move, and leaves People on every phone in the family.

export.excelHint: Every gift, person and function, as a spreadsheet to share or keep.
export.failed: Couldn't make the file. Try again.
export.name: Name

more.title: More
more.languageHint: Saved to your account, so your other phones switch too.
more.appLockHint: Ask for your fingerprint, face or phone PIN when the app opens, or after a minute away.
more.appLockUnavailable: Set a screen lock (PIN, pattern or fingerprint) on this phone first.
more.appLockWeb: App lock works in the phone app, not the web preview.
more.signOutConfirm: Sign out on this phone? Your ledgers stay here and return when you sign in again.

errors.newPersonName: Pick a person or type a new name
errors.personId: That person is no longer in the ledger
errors.title: Give the event a name
errors.eventId: This event is no longer in the ledger
errors.name: Give the ledger a name
errors.pickPerson: More than one person has this name. Pick one from the list.
errors.generic: That didn't save. Check the form and try again.

cash.title: Count the cash
cash.shortHint: Usually a missed envelope or a mistyped amount. Check the entries below.
cash.overHint: A gift may not be logged yet. Log it, then count again.
cash.tickHint: Tick envelopes as you find them. To fix a wrong amount, long press the entry on the event screen.
cash.empty: No cash gifts logged for this event yet
cash.keptNote: Every count is kept for the family's record

signIn.tagline: Every shagun your family gives and receives, in one ledger that works even without signal.
signIn.f3: Full give-and-take history with any family
signIn.googleMissing: Google sign-in isn't set up in this build. Use a development build with EXPO_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_WEB_CLIENT_ID.
signIn.contactsNote: We'll ask for contacts only when you first search them.
signIn.devHint: Only for testing with a local server (DEV_LOGIN=true).
signIn.needsInternet: Signing in needs the internet once. After that the app works offline.

lock.title: Shagun Register is locked
lock.body: Use your fingerprint, face or phone PIN to open your family's ledger.
lock.lockout: Too many tries. Wait a little, or unlock the phone with its PIN, then try again.

family.title: Family members
family.shareMessage: Join our family gift ledger “{{name}}” on Shagun Register. Open the app and enter code {{code}} (valid for 48 hours).
family.ownerCan: Owner · everything, including invites and roles
family.editorCan: Editor · add and edit gifts, people, events
family.viewerCan: Viewer · see the ledger and export
family.removeConfirm: Remove {{name}}? They lose access to this ledger on every phone.
family.leaveConfirm: Leave {{name}}? Its records are removed from this phone.
family.offline: You're offline. Members and invites need the internet; the ledger itself still works.
family.notRegistered: This ledger is saved on this phone but not on the server yet. Connect to the internet to invite family.
family.viewerNote: You can see this ledger but not change it. Ask the owner to make you an editor.

apiErrors.NETWORK: No internet connection. Try again when you're online.
apiErrors.NOT_CONFIGURED: The app isn't connected to a server. Set EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL.
apiErrors.INVITE_INVALID: That code is wrong or has expired. Ask for a new one.
apiErrors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many tries. Wait a few minutes and try again.
apiErrors.ROLE_FORBIDDEN: Only the owner can do that.
apiErrors.OWNER_CANNOT_LEAVE: The owner can't leave their own ledger.
apiErrors.CONFLICT: This ledger already exists on the server.
